How to get it :
- [[Ore Acidizer|Ore Acidizer]] : ore (beryllium), 500 mB Hydrogen Peroxide.
- [[Ore Acidizer|Ore Acidizer]] : raw ore (beryllium), 333 mB Hydrogen Peroxide.

Used to make :
[[gv:powder_beryllium|Beryllium Powder]], [[gv:ingot_beryllium|Beryllium Ingot]].
